text: Connect an MCP client through an authentication workflow, with permission for all graphs or a selection
description:
Felix 2026-11-12: for connecting MCPs, build an authenticate workflow with permission: all graphs, or just a selection of graphs (repos).

This is how an agent acts on a server: through a person's account, limited to the graphs that person chose. Felix 2026-11-11: non-human agents get a user identity too and are shown on the ideas they work on while they work.

Today: the UI has "Copy MCP link", which carries the account's token in the address (?token=) or as a bearer header (mcp/src/sse.ts); the token has all rights of the account, on the one project the server hosts. af701cd6 had planned a login page opened by the MCP client, which was not built.

Not designed: whether the agent appears under the person's name or under a name of its own tied to that person.

status.comment: Planned 2026-11-12 at Felix's request; nothing built. Needs accounts (383e8949) and access per graph (8faf6a70).
